svg.text: BellmanLab | a proposed policy is not an evaluated policy
Same one-state uncertainty set in every row. Only the evaluation caps change. Discount = 1/2.
Value is an upper bound for risky policy. Controller improvement is withheld.
Risky value is exact. Proposed safe controller [1] is NOT returned as evaluated.
Safe controller [1] and nature [0] are evaluated. Both stability checks pass.
Inner exact solve: evaluate nature [0] at 4/5, improve to [1], then evaluate -4/5 and verify stability.
Outer improvement then selects safe [1]. Its exact value is 2/5; total: 2 controller / 3 nature evaluations.
Full nested histories contain solved equations, worst-case ties, residuals and separate unevaluated proposals.
Stability proves robust optimality, not policy uniqueness. Inner caps never manufacture outer improvements.
Full exact demo embedded in SVG metadata. Prescribed model and budgets, not a speed or learning benchmark.
